title: The Release of the 108 Stars
content_zh:
Minister Hong Xin, by imperial decree, traveled to Dragon Tiger Mountain to request the Celestial Master to pray for relief from a plague. His arrogance offended the mountain, and he ignored all warnings.
In the Suppression of Demons Hall, Hong Xin pried open a stone slab sealed with generations of Daoist talismans. A thunderous crack, a pillar of black smoke, and one hundred and eight stars of destiny shot into the sky, scattering across the land.
These 108 stars would be reborn as 108 outlaws, destined to gather at Liangshan Marsh, to fight corruption, defend the weak, and shake the Song Dynasty to its foundations.
